items.name: Bass Clef Gator
items.blurb: Monet's low-register alligator stays low at the walker's side, keeping bass clef rhythm grounded.

items.name: Delta Core Pouch
items.blurb: Darwin's side satchel holds the Core apple and Delta crystal, keeping raw tables ready for notebook pipelines.

items.blurb: Forged for Charles Darwin's Databricks expedition, uniting cluster gears with an illuminated Delta crest across the chest.

items.name: Surrogate Cuffs
items.blurb: Forged for Isaac Newton's star schema model, binding the wrists in gold-keyed gauntlets that lock dimensions into consistent rows.

items.name: Monet's Pedal Sabatons
items.blurb: Padded leather sabatons dyed in water-lily teal, tipped with brass damper brackets so Claude Monet can ground every bass note firmly to the pedals.
